summary: Public CMS list/detail reads hide drafts, archived entries and deleted records unless the established actor has the appropriate preview permission; deleted content remains hidden from all readers.
Content writes validate object shape, known fields, locale, typed values and explicit null/default semantics before entry, revision or audit mutation; public nested query DTOs are detached.
Publication revalidates the current schema, blocks terminal-state resurrection and preserves history on repeated accepted publication.

Expanded the regression suite to 34 cases covering actual HTTP handlers, authenticated sessions and tokens, malformed inputs, rejection-state preservation, numeric ordering and nested object ownership.
Replaced mismatched staged learning chapters with nine source-grounded guides, exercises/solutions, actual code excerpts and explicit process-memory and webhook limitations.

checks.command: Full Vitest suite and recorded TypeScript/build checks; ESLint

limits: The CMS store remains process-local demo state and does not establish database durability.
Webhook delivery behavior remains documented as a demo limitation.
Demo role authentication is available only with explicit non-production opt-in.
